title: Family Tree
about: The ridiculous and ever-growing State Arts-In family tree built from inside jokes and chosen relationships.
description: This track remembers the unofficial family tree that grew through State Arts-In, where people casually became siblings, parents, grandparents, cousins, and adopted family with almost no concern for logic. I somehow became Will's grandma, Lanny became my 4-H father, Vicky adopted people freely, and Emma managed to make the already-confusing tree even harder to follow. None of it needed to make sense because the relationships were really about friendship, belonging, and the running joke that there was always room for another branch.

That's exactly why we loved it...
And why we never let it end.

That's just how the branches swayed.

Then Emma broke what little logic
Where nothing grows the way it should.
Still somehow it all looked good.
None of it makes any sense.
That's exactly why we loved it...

Charts and graphs would all give up,
